title: Modeling Like Peeling an Onion: Layerwise Analysis-Driven Automatic Behavioral Model Generation
summary: The original LATO pipeline uses a layerwise LLM workflow to identify behavioral activities, extract nested relations, integrate the information, generate PlantUML activity diagrams, and iteratively validate diagram syntax.
This reproduction replaces the full LATO workflow with a simplified single-LLM prompt that directly generates one PlantUML activity diagram from each requirement text.
